correctness.summary: The published lower bound gives MOP(n,2)>=ceil((4n+10)/9) for every n>=5. Starting from the published extremal ladder H_k on 18k+2 vertices, each listed residue template consists only of boundary-ear insertions, which preserve maximal outerplanarity. Direct degree updates show that the largest three-consecutive-degree window is exactly ceil((4n+10)/9) for every residue and every k>=1, proving equality for n>=20; explicit triangulations handle n=14..19. Exhaustive recursive enumeration of all convex-polygon triangulations for n=5..13 gives the exact remaining values and reproduces the corresponding Catalan counts.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The current accessible main text of arXiv:2609.19762v1 proves equality only for n congruent to 2 modulo 18 and an additive-43 upper bound in general. It explicitly reports finite computer verification of seventeen additional caps and states the all-n>=14 formula only as a presumption. The originality claim here is restricted to the uniform proof for all residue classes and the complete exact n>=5 determination, not the conjectural formula or the general idea of altered caps. The source paper's supplementary material was not inspected and is the principal residual risk: it may contain overlapping cap data, and an unadvertised uniform proof there would weaken or eliminate originality of the n>=14 part. The inspected 2019 precursor gives only the older 4n/9 lower bound and a 5n/11-scale construction.

value.summary: The result closes the additive-constant gap in the newest work, proves its explicitly anticipated exact formula for every n>=14, and completely determines MOP(n,2) for every n>=5, with exactly six small exceptional orders. The boundary-ear templates give explicit optimal graphs in every residue class while retaining the published periodic core.

limitations: The supplementary material referenced by arXiv:2609.19762v1 was not inspected and may overlap the residue constructions.
The exact values for orders 5 through 13 use exhaustive computer-assisted enumeration of polygon triangulations.
No originality is claimed for the conjectural all-n formula itself or for the general idea of residue-specific end caps, both of which are already indicated in the 2026 source.
The theorem concerns only spread width 2 in maximal outerplanar graphs.
Independent audit has not been performed.
